review_locator: PMCID:PMC2901818, Integrin alphaVbeta3-Targeted Cancer Therapy; PMCID:PMC4505771, Utilizing Fibronectin Integrin-Binding Specificity to Control Cellular Responses
primary_title: The vitronectin receptor alpha v beta 3 binds fibronectin and acts in concert with alpha 5 beta 1 in promoting cellular attachment and spreading on fibronectin
decision_basis: The reviews identify alphaVbeta3 as an RGD-binding fibronectin receptor and the cited primary study directly demonstrates high-affinity fibronectin binding by purified alphaVbeta3 plus alphaVbeta3-dependent melanoma-cell adhesion and spreading.
limitations_preserved: Preserve fibronectin RGD ligand form and the alphaVbeta3/alpha5beta1 cooperative adhesion context; no autonomous ITGAV relay or SCI inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC8912536, The Molecular Interaction of Collagen with Cell Receptors for Biological Function; PMCID:PMC1952532, Structural Basis of Integrin Regulation and Signaling
primary_title: The collagen-binding A-domains of integrins alpha(1)beta(1) and alpha(2)beta(1) recognize the same specific amino acid sequence, GFOGER, in native (triple-helical) collagens
decision_basis: The reviews identify collagen I GFOGER as a high-affinity ligand motif for alpha1beta1 and cite primary peptide-binding and alpha1beta1-dependent cell-adhesion evidence.
limitations_preserved: Preserve triple-helical collagen I and the GFOGER/hydroxyproline motif, alpha1beta1 heterodimer, and cation dependence; no universal collagen relay or SCI inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC8912536, The Molecular Interaction of Collagen with Cell Receptors for Biological Function; PMCID:PMC2740402, Structural Insights into the Interactions between Platelet Receptors and Fibrillar Collagen
primary_title: The collagen-binding A-domains of integrins alpha(1)beta(1) and alpha(2)beta(1) recognize the same specific amino acid sequence, GFOGER, in native (triple-helical) collagens
decision_basis: The reviews identify collagen I GFOGER as a high-affinity ligand motif for alpha2beta1 and cite primary peptide-binding and alpha2beta1-dependent platelet/HT1080 adhesion evidence.
limitations_preserved: Preserve triple-helical collagen I and the GFOGER/hydroxyproline motif, alpha2beta1 heterodimer, and cation dependence; GPVI is a separate collagen receptor and no SCI inference is added.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC6744579, Structural biology of laminins; PMID:23076212, Laminin-511: a multi-functional adhesion protein review
primary_title: Human mast cells adhere to and migrate on epithelial and vascular basement membrane laminins LM-332 and LM-511 via alpha3beta1 integrin
decision_basis: The reviews identify alpha3beta1 as a laminin-511 receptor and the cited primary study shows alpha3beta1-dependent human mast-cell adhesion and migration on laminin-511.
limitations_preserved: Preserve laminin-511 isoform and alpha3beta1 heterodimer, antibody-blocking and mast-cell context; no purified-affinity constant or SCI inference.
